g.text: I'm a Senior Full Stack and Mobile Engineer and Team Lead. At Devsinc I lead cross-functional teams building
TypeScript products for international clients, owning architecture, code review, mentoring, CI/CD and
reliable releases. My products have shipped across many industries, from real estate and fintech to
React, Next.js and Remix front ends
Node.js, NestJS, Python and Go APIs
PostgreSQL, REST and GraphQL, on AWS
React Native and Flutter for iOS and Android
Live tracking, payments, push, store releases
Electron for Windows, macOS and Linux
Complete desktop apps, end to end
OpenAI and Claude APIs, tool calling
Lead teams shipping web and mobile products: architecture, code reviews, mentoring, CI/CD and production incidents.
Led delivery of DApps with Solidity and Rust smart contracts, plus React and React Native apps.
Built web and mobile apps, REST APIs and payment integrations for client products.
From the requirement to a reliable
Open to senior full stack, mobile, AI engineering and team lead roles. Email me or connect on LinkedIn.
